data.name: 竞速驾驶
data.detailed_description:
This is a 2D retro cartoon single-player time trial driving game that gets back to the essence of racing! Bright cartoon visuals + retro pixel textures, paired with upbeat nostalgic BGM, instantly transport you back to the thrilling days of arcade halls. No complicated controls needed—just pick it up and enjoy pure driving joy!

Core Gameplay

1. Pure Time Trial Challenge: A single core track focused solely on speed duels! Your sole goal is to push your limits and set the fastest lap record. Every launch and cornering decision impacts your final time.

2. Precision Controls + Authentic Feel: Dual support for virtual buttons and controllers. Light taps steer, smooth drifts flow. The physics engine replicates real racing inertia and friction—mastering cornering lines is all about skill. Beginners can dive right in, while veterans can hone their racing lines to perfection.

4. Retro Tracks with Hidden Secrets: Consecutive hairpins, long straightaway accelerations, and concealed shortcuts distill classic racing essence. Every run reveals new optimization potential—enjoy the full thrill of record-breaking achievements during spare moments!

  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Microsoft Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-3570K or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 970 or equivalent
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
